description: This file defines the UpgradeCommand class, which manages the upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system via CLI. It includes methods for configuring the command, executing the upgrade through multiple steps (database info gathering, compatibility/system checks, running migration scripts, and updating configuration files), and handling user interactions.

classes.name: UpgradeCommand
classes.description: Handles the command-line process for upgrading the OrangeHRM system, including database configuration, system checks, running migrations, and updating configuration files. Extends InstallerCommand and uses helper traits.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name and sets command aliases.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines command-line options required for the upgrade process, such as database connection info and version.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that coordinates the upgrade process, including user prompts, system checks, running migrations, and updating configs.

methods.name: drawDatabaseInfoTable
methods.description: Displays the database connection parameters in a formatted table.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a given command-line option has a non-empty value.

methods.name: throwIfParamEmpty
methods.description: Throws an exception if a required option is missing or empty.
